verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins is a law firm offering legal services plus free informational resources: LathamDrive, a document generator, and a glossary app. Issuing scoped API credentials for agents is not a fair axis for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships any API at all. The llms.txt and OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
